name: Miriam Schapiro
summary:
Miriam "Mimi" Schapiro was a Canadian-born artist based in the United States. She was a painter, sculptor, printmaker, and a pioneer of feminist art. She was also considered a leader of the Pattern and Decoration art movement. Her artwork blurs the line between fine art and craft. She incorporated craft elements into her paintings due to their association with women and femininity.

She often used icons that are associated with women, such as hearts, floral decorations, geometric patterns, and the color pink. Miriam Schapiro was a painters & sculptors from Toronto (1923-11-15, Toronto–2015-06-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Miriam Schapiro's work as a pioneer of feminist art and leader of the Pattern and Decoration movement contributed to the expansion of women's representation in the art world. Her incorporation of craft elements into fine art paved the way for future generations of female artists.
